subject: stats: optimize stats table copy to save memory (#63004)
summary: Introduces `statistics.Table.CopyAs(CopyIntent)` to replace unconditional deep/shallow copies with intent-based copying (meta-only, map-writable, extended-stats-writable, or full deep copy). Updates stats loading/bootstrap/sync-load and planner determinate-mode paths to select the minimal safe copy level, reducing memory pressure while keeping copy-on-write safety; adds unit coverage for CopyAs sharing/cloning behavior.
